annotations.title: Check whether a floor plan file is ready to upload

description: Checks a floor plan file against VEDUTUM’s upload rules before anyone uploads it: file type, size, pages, scan or vector, scale, title block. Use when someone asks which format to export from CAD (Archicad, Revit, AutoCAD, Vectorworks) or whether a scan or photo of a plan works. Nothing is uploaded.

has_dimensions.description: True if the plan shows at least one dimension line or a scale bar

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

scanned_or_photo.description: True if the plan is a scan or a photo rather than a CAD export

title_block_with_names.description: True if a title block with names or an address is on the page

name: vedutum_check_floor_plan
title: Check whether a floor plan file is ready to upload
